games.title: Emoji Hunter
games.shortDescription: Can Bluey survive the long dark cold night? Help them defend against mobs of monsters, zombies and freaky demons of all kinds and stay alive for as long as possible.
games.longDescription: In this sentient universe, Bluey was just another block of stinky tofu waiting to be thrown into a hot pot. Yet on one unfortunate night, he was accidentally thrown out and left to rot in the alley ways and the gritty streets of the downtown food district. Can he survive the dangers that come with leaving his cozy kitchen? Help him stay alive as long as you can.
